name: 41992-imageprompt-kimivl-a3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine, one process, no NCCL.
load_profile: constant (OPEN loop), rate = 8.0 req/s, bounded at 200 requests, warmup the first 20% by completion, 600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` plus TWO `synthetic_image` datasets zipped row-wise into ONE request: two distinct 448x448 jpegs (quality 85, gradient content, seeds 42 and 43) and a 32-token question, answered in exactly 64 tokens, single turn, greedy.
purpose: A visual comparison assistant answering short two-image questions with 64-token replies at eight requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Flat file: every key top-level, every value on ONE line, no inline `#`.
# `trust-remote-code` is required, not decorative: this checkpoint ships its processor as
# repository code, and without it the tokenizer/processor load fails outright.
# `limit-mm-per-prompt` must equal the image count in scenario.json exactly — the engine admits
# one image per prompt by default.
# `gpu-memory-utilization` is 0.60 on purpose and is not the engine default. The fraction is
# taken against TOTAL device memory, so it fixes the same KV pool on both runs whatever else is
# on the card, and this workload's KV footprint is negligible beside it — see configs/note.md.

model: moonshotai/Kimi-VL-A3B-Instruct
trust-remote-code: true
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 2}
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-num-seqs: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.60
compilation-config: {"cudagraph_mm_encoder": true, "encoder_cudagraph_token_budgets": [256, 512, 1024], "encoder_cudagraph_max_vision_items_per_batch": 4}
